caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, earthenware jar positioned upright in the center of the composition. The jar has an elongated, oval shape with a slightly narrower bottom and a wide, straight neck with a lip that flares outward. Two symmetrical, small looped handles are attached to the upper sides of the jar near the neck. The entire surface is beige with brownish tones and is covered in numerous irregular dark spots, giving the appearance of a speckled or mottled texture. Near the top, just below the neck, there is handwriting that reads "Thos. M. Odom." The drawing is framed within a faint rectangular outline on an off-white or cream-colored background. In the bottom right corner of the outlined frame, the artist's name "Annie B. Johnston" is written in small letters. There are no additional objects or colors within the composition.
title: Stoneware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
